cues.text: You stand with Akihiko at Naganaki Shrine, worn out after training alongside him.
A gang of about ten men walks up and spreads out around you both, led by the men from before.
You step up beside Akihiko and raise your fists. Akihiko looks at you in surprise.
The gang rushes you, and a fight breaks out. Soon every one of them is beaten, slumped on the ground around you, and Akihiko walks over to you.
